comment: Committed regression-baseline bounds (ADR-0008). `recorded` = criterion 0.7.0 median ns/iteration measured with --save-baseline gate; the gate fails when a future median exceeds `recorded * tolerance_factor`. The 2x factor is deliberate: CI runs on ubuntu-latest and developer machines differ, so this is a loud cross-machine guard, not a precise comparator. Re-record after intentional performance work using the protocol in scripts/bench_gate.py.
